title: AI Code Review in 2026: Why It's a Must
full_monologue: **By 2026, every developer needs an AI code review agent.** Why? They catch bugs faster, improve performance, and keep your code clean—without burning out. Imagine an AI that learns your style, suggests optimizations, and even helps with documentation. It’s like having a 24/7 coding mentor. And with AI handling the routine, you can focus on the big picture. Ready to level up your workflow? Let me know in the comments!
